message: Hi, my kid Nora is 10 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey! Yes, we do! We have Youth No-Gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for kids ages 7–13, so Nora would be a great fit. It's structured just for her age group in a really supportive environment. Would you like to get her signed up for a free trial class?
Yes, that sounds great! When is the next available trial class?
Perfect! For Nora's age group (9–12), classes are Monday and Wednesday from 6:00–6:45 PM, plus Saturday at 10:00 AM. Which day works best for her first trial?
Let's go with Monday at 6:00 PM for her first trial class.
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial confirmation to?
You can send the confirmation to tester.ember@gmail.com.
Perfect! And is this the best number to reach you at if we need to?
Yes, you can reach me at 860-555-0504.
Great! Now I just need Nora's full name and date of birth to complete the booking.
Nora's full name is Nora Ember, and her birthday is April 18, 2016.
I see the next Monday class at 6:00 PM is actually today, July 6th, or we have Wednesday, July 8th at 6:00 PM available. Which would work better for Nora's trial?
Let's go with Wednesday, July 8th at 6:00 PM for Nora's trial class.

Perfect! Nora is all set for Wednesday, July 8th at 6:00 PM. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.ember@gmail.com. Just have her wear comfortable athletic clothes. No experience or equipment needed. See you both then!
